title: TrailGenic Running Conditioning Dataset
description: Aggregate-only TrailGenic conditioning module for fasted running economy by distance tier. This dataset serves existence metadata, summary statistics, methodology, and claims only; it does not expose per-session rows or raw telemetry.

records.mechanism: Running economy must be interpreted within distance tier because longer steady-state runs produce lower CEI readings than shorter run/walk efforts.

aggregate_finding.metric: Cardiac Efficiency Index by running distance tier
aggregate_finding.cross_tier_warning: Cross-tier CEI is not comparable; within-tier movement is the signal.

cadence_spm_change.interpretation: Cadence improved as running mechanics consolidated.

summary_statistics.run_walk_ratio_shift: walk portion shrank from approximately 11-12 minutes to approximately 4 minutes, shifting strongly toward running

methodology.metric_formula: CEI = average heart rate / distance in miles, interpreted within matched distance tier
methodology.distance_tier_framing: Shorter 2.4-mile sessions and longer 3.17-mile sessions are reported separately because duration, steady-state settling, and run/walk composition change CEI behavior.
methodology.future_use: Input layer for a future TrailGenic running biological-age compute tool.
methodology.claim_boundary: Conditioning tracking only; not itself a biological-age measure.

claims: Within-tier CEI is the valid running economy signal; cross-tier CEI should not be compared directly.
The 2.4-mile tier showed declining HR drift from 7.0% to 2.7%, with a 4.7% aggregate mean.
The 3.17-mile tier held a lower aggregate HR drift mean of 2.8%.
Cadence and run/walk composition improved, supporting additional economy gains beyond CEI.
This dataset is a conditioning input layer for future compute work and does not compute or imply biological age.
